description: This file contains the implementation of the ClientGrainLocator class, which implements the IGrainLocator interface for locating grains within the Orleans distributed system. It manages grain address lookups, cache invalidation, and handles client-specific grain identification.

classes.name: ClientGrainLocator
classes.description: An internal class that implements IGrainLocator to locate client grains using in-memory distributed directory.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously looks up the address of a grain by its GrainId, returning a GrainAddress.

methods.name: SelectAddress
methods.description: Selects an appropriate GrainAddress from a list of results, prioritizing local silo address.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Throws InvalidOperationException as explicit registration is not supported for client grains.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Throws InvalidOperationException as explicit unregistration is not supported for client grains.

methods.name: ThrowNotClientGrainId
methods.description: Static method that throws an exception if a GrainId is not a client ID.

methods.name: TryLookupInCache
methods.description: Attempts to find a grain address in the local cache for a given GrainId.
